title: Numerical Gradient Check
signature: def grad_check(f, x: np.ndarray, analytic_grad: np.ndarray, h: float = 1e-5) -> tuple
hints: Use central differences, (f(x + h) - f(x - h)) / (2h). Its error is O(h^2), compared with O(h) for the one-sided version.
Perturb one element at a time. np.ndindex(x.shape) visits every index of an array of any shape.
Save the old value and put it back after both evaluations, so x is unchanged when you return.
